title: Dataset Creation and Baseline Models for Sexism Detection in Hausa

bias_targets.methodology: Creation of a Hausa language dataset for sexism detection involving native speakers and translation of English datasets, followed by the evaluation of machine learning classifiers (SVM, BERT, mBERT, XLM-R) and few-shot Large Language Models (GPT-5, Grok, Deepseek) in distinguishing sexist from non-sexist content.
